elenchusLines: 165-568 (items on lines ~178-193; Notitia follows, not an Elenchus item)

entries.author: ANONYMUS (Continuator Theophanis)
entries.title: Chronographia, Theophani continuanda, Constantini Porphyrogeniti imp. jussu scripta, libris IV
entries.note: Elenchus heading 'Scriptores post Theophanem ex edit. Fr. Combefisii' (no column). Head at OCR line 398 sits on page 15/16; Notitia and Prooemium follow at cols 17+.

entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: De vita et rebus gestis avi sui Basilii Macedonis
entries.note: Head 'HISTORIA DE VITA ET REBUS GESTIS BASILII' (Lib. V). Ordo lists Basilius Macedo with garbled number.

entries.author: ANONYMI
entries.title: Libri duo De vita Leonis Philosophi, Alexandri et Romani junioris, impp.
entries.note: Elenchus 309 falls inside Lib. V (Basilius Macedo, cols ~301-315), so garbled. OCR shows 'LIBER VI. IMPERIUM LEONIS IMPERATORIS' on page 369/370 (page 368 numbered at line 26144, 372 at line 26486); Ordo prints '$10' read as 370. Contains Leo, Alexander (head ~393), Constantinus Porphyrogenitus and Romanus junior under Lib. VI, running to col ~498. bodyCol is inferred from neighbouring page numbers, the head's own page number being lost.

entries.author: ANONYMUS
entries.title: Dissertatio steliteutica contra Iconomachos, scripta circa an. 745
entries.note: OCR shows heading 'AD SEQUENTEM INVECTIVAM PROLUSIO' at 499/500, then Greek/Latin 'Dissertatio ac invectiva orthodoxorum (contra haereticos)' at 500 (Ordo: Prolusio 499, Invectiva 502).

entries.author: JOANNES HIEROSOLYMITANUS
entries.title: Narratio de origine motuum Iconoclastarum
entries.note: Elenchus '317' falls inside Theophanes Continuatus Lib. VI; Ordo prints '$18' (518). Title block (Greek 'IQANNOY ... IEPOSOAYMITOY MONAXOY AIHTHZIS' then Latin) at lines 37220-37236 on page 517/518; an earlier 'NARRATIO.' running head at line 37207. Notitia text says p. 519,515 (printed pagination of Combefis, not columns).

entries.author: JOANNES CAMENIATA
entries.title: Narratio de excidio Thessalonicae; praemittitur excerptum ex miraculis S. Demetrii martyris
entries.note: First head is Combefis' MONITUM at 519/520 (line 37340); the Demetrius miracula excerpt (Greek 'EK TON TOY AGLOFOPOY AHMHTPIOY ... THAUMATOURGION' + Latin) begins ~520 (line 37490); Joannes Cameniata Narratio proper begins ~523 (line 37584, Ordo: Miracula Demetrii 523 [OCR '023'], Notitia 519). One Elenchus title, several heads.

entries.author: DEMETRIUS CYDONIUS
entries.title: Monodia in Thessalonicenses occisos (cum Combefisii Praefatione)
entries.note: Listed in the closing Ordo ('Monodia Demetrii Cydonii occisorum Thessalonicae', Ordo reads 639) but omitted by the Elenchus. Combefis' 'In sequentem Demetrii Cydonii Monodiam ... Praefatio' begins at line 46320 (col 638|639), the Greek head 'DEMETRIOU KYDONIOU MONODIA EPI TOIS EN THESSALONIKE PESOUSI' at line 46366 under running head '639 DEMETRII CYDONII 640' (line 46328); the page-number chain gives 639. Greek and Latin.

entries.author: GREGORIUS MONACHUS
entries.title: Ex Vita Basilii Junioris
entries.note: Head block at line 47283-47363: Combefis' Praefatio, then Greek 'EK TOY BIOY BAZIAEIOY TOY NEOY' and Latin 'EX BASILII JUNIORIS VITA auctore Gregorio ejus discipulo'; running head 654 at line 47283.

entries.author: SYMEON MAGISTER ET LOGOTHETA
entries.title: Annales a Leone Armeno ad Nicephorum Phocam
entries.note: Page 663/664 opens with Combefis' praefatio; Greek 'ZYMEON MAGISTROU KAI LOGOTHETOU CHRONOGRAPHIA' and Latin 'ANNALES a Leone Armenio ad Nicephorum Phocam' follow at line 47987-47998. Ordo gives sub-books (Leo Armenius 663 etc.) not entered here.

entries.author: GEORGIUS MONACHUS
entries.title: Vitae recentiorum imperatorum
entries.note: Head 'GEORGII MONACHI BIOI TON NEON BASILEON / Vitae recentiorum imperatorum' at page 823/824 (running head 824 at line 59870). Ordo prints 825 (page after).

entries.author: JOSEPHUS GENESIUS
entries.title: Historia de rebus Constantinopolitanis
entries.note: Title page 'JOSEPHUS GENESIUS' + Notitia at 985 (line 72346, after col 983 page); Lachmann's Praefatio at ~989/990 (line 72509); text head 'HISTORIA DE REBUS CONSTANTINOPOLITANIS ... REGUM LIBER I' at ~989/990 (line 72588, col map reads 990). Ordo's number for this item is garbled; Ordo Lib. II 1026, III 1054, IV 1090, Index 1155.

problems: Notitia (cols 11-14 of the Combefis preface to the whole volume) and Prooemium (17+) are not Elenchus items and have no entries.

Ordo RERUM text for several lines is badly garbled (Leo '$10', Genesius). Item 3's bodyCol is derived from adjacent page numbers (368, 372) because the head page's own number is lost; two-page ambiguity 369/370.

Ordo-only apparatus not entered: Notitia and Praefatio Combefisii to the volume (Ordo 9), Prooemium, Combefisii Praefatio ad Annales Symeonis (Ordo 663), Praefatio ad excerpta Vitae Basilii Junioris, Monitum ad Cameniatae narrationem (519), Index historicus in Scriptores post Theophanem and Index historicus in Genesium (Ordo 1155). Ordo-only work added: Demetrius Cydonius, Monodia (col 639).
